purpose: Define the Contract Format 1.4 Master as the explicit bootstrap authority for active top-level canonical roots, registries and validation entry points without absorbing child semantics.

does_not_own: child semantic content unless explicitly stated

semantics.purpose: Define the Contract Format 1.4 Master as the explicit bootstrap authority for active top-level canonical roots, registries and validation entry points without absorbing child semantics.

semantics.bootstrap_rule: Master explicitly declares active canonical roots and top-level registries.
semantics.child_rule: Master references child definitions; it does not duplicate or own their internal semantics.
semantics.filesystem_rule: File presence or directory depth does not create active-root status.
semantics.history_rule: Historical/superseded material is excluded from active-root resolution unless explicitly referenced as history.
semantics.validation_rule: Master exposes repository-wide validation entry points.
semantics.topic_rule: Master itself participates in Topic coverage and traceability.
semantics.active_root_rule: active_root_refs are semantic/navigation entry surfaces within the explicit active_contract_refs source set. Root membership does not replace or implicitly expand the active source set.
semantics.active_root_selection_basis: Each listed identity is an existing canonical contract whose own source_role or machine-readable semantics declares a canonical/core/namespace root or membership/boundary-master role.
semantics.active_contract_rule: Master is loaded first, then canonical/json/** may be recursively scanned only as a candidate-source set. A candidate becomes part of the active canonical source set only when its exact identity is listed in active_contract_refs, its source_role is allowed by Contract Format, and exactly one compatible active definition resolves.
semantics.candidate_discovery_rule: Filesystem traversal discovers candidate source documents only. File presence, path, depth, mtime and traversal order never create canonical authority.

invariants.rule: Repository activation, migration state, validation state and replacement decisions are explicit and machine-readable.

hard_gates.condition: active root inferred from filesystem presence
historical root competes with active root
required active root missing or ambiguous

references.purpose: Master is the explicit canonical bootstrap authority.
